bugs.description: The comparison `subtotal < threshold` is backwards: it assigns a tier's rate when the subtotal is BELOW the threshold, so small subtotals end up overwritten by the highest tier's rate last. Per the docstring (inclusive of threshold, highest qualifying tier wins), it should be `subtotal >= threshold`.
synonyms: small orders get the biggest discount
small subtotals get the highest discount
less than should be greater than

bugs.description: The default `shipping=-5.0` is a negative value; a real shipping cost default should be positive (e.g. +5.0). As written, every order silently gets a $5 discount instead of a $5 shipping charge when the caller omits shipping.
synonyms: sign is flipped on default shipping
negative shipping cost doesn't make sense
default shipping subtracts instead of adds

bugs.description: `order_totals[1:n]` does not select the last n elements of the list; it skips the first element and takes indices 1..n-1 from the front. The correct tail slice is `order_totals[-n:]`.
synonyms: doesn't take the last n elements
does not take the last n
slices from the front instead of the back
